fields: as a table: cols, rows, nav, and map: [{c: "ON", n: "Ontario", x: 4, y: 1, r: 0}] one tile per province or territory: code, name, column and row on the grid, and r, the index of the row that covers it (no invented places, only the tiles it lists); base: {c: "ON", label: "Based in Ontario"} (optional) the tile marked as home, with its label (copy from the page); its row is on the readout when the page opens.
best_for: CoverageMap sets a coverage table by region as one column per region beside an instrument readout: the region in hand, its severity 1 on-site time as the large figure, a seal stamp naming the CRN body and the engineering seal, and the tile map with its provinces lit.
